input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including account, note. The platform provides capabilities for trimmed, account. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage account records, so that I can track and organize account data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage note records, so that I can track and organize note data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with welcome functionality, so that I can accomplish my welcome-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use trimmed capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
